newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia, Deutsch Telekom sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia, Deutsch Telekom sign agreement.

text.p: Tunisia's telecommunications agency and Germany's Deutsch Telekom signed on Monday an agreement establishing a multimedia numerical link between the two countries, officials said.

The agreement was signed in presence of German Posts and Telecommunications Minister Wolfang Boetch who is visiting Tunisia with a delegation including German telecommunications businessmen for talks with his Tunisian counterpart Habib Ammar.
The service, which allows high speed transmission of voice, is called "Tuniris" and is operated by state-controlled agency Tunisie Telecom.
